title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a single face with one loop consisting of eight lines. The first line starts at the origin [0.0, 0.0] and ends at [0.0377, 0.0]. The second line starts at [0.0377, 0.0] and ends at [0.0377, 0.0053]. The third line starts at [0.0377, 0.0053] and ends at [0.0215, 0.0053]. The fourth line starts at [0.0215, 0.0053] and ends at [0.0215, 0.0377]. The fifth line starts at [0.0215, 0.0377] and ends at [0.0162, 0.0377]. The sixth line starts at [0.0162, 0.0377] and ends at [0.0162, 0.0053]. The seventh line starts at [0.0162, 0.0053] and ends at [0.0, 0.0053]. The eighth line starts at [0.0, 0.0053] and returns to the origin [0.0, 0.0]. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0377 to the two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles set to zero and translate it using a translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body with this part. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.037726358148893364, a width of 0.037726358148893364, and a height of 0.75 units.

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
X = 0.0377   # flange width
Y = 0.0377   # total depth (flange thickness + web height)
Z = 0.7500   # extrusion height

# Plate thicknesses
tf = 0.0075  # flange thickness
tw = 0.0075  # web thickness

# T-shaped profile: horizontal flange with a central web stem
# Flange: from y=0 to y=tf, spanning full width X
# Web: centered in X, from y=tf to y=Y
profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(X, 0.0)
    .lineTo(X, tf)
    .lineTo((X + tw) / 2.0, tf)
    .lineTo((X + tw) / 2.0, Y)
    .lineTo((X - tw) / 2.0, Y)
    .lineTo((X - tw) / 2.0, tf)
    .lineTo(0.0, tf)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the T-profile along Z
r = profile.extrude(Z)

import cadquery as cq

# Build the T-shaped cross-section on the XY plane, then extrude along Z
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    # Flange (bottom bar of the T)
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0377, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0377, 0.005)
    # Right side up to the stem
    .lineTo(0.02135, 0.005)
    # Stem (vertical bar of the T)
    .lineTo(0.02135, 0.0377)
    .lineTo(0.01635, 0.0377)
    .lineTo(0.01635, 0.005)
    # Left side back down to the flange
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.005)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.75)
)
